name: Quinpl
summary: Dive into the brain-teasing world of Quinpl, a Japanese puzzle adventure. Your goal is to clear a path to the exit door by leaping over and blasting through blocks and monsters. Arm your character with retractable stakes that not only eliminate enemies but also anchor to walls—letting you jump higher, break barriers, and uncover hidden routes. Be careful, though: one touch from a creature or treacherous terrain transforms you into a helpless blue frog and costs you a life.
